title: Direct Post-Training Preference Alignment for Multi-Agent Motion Generation Model Using Implicit Feedback from Pre-training Demonstrations

layout.note: Three coloured headings over three regions in a row: grey Model Pre-training at the left (scene icon box, model bar with curves and token chips), orange Direct Preference Alignment in the middle (database and two circular arrows with the objective formula above), blue Preference Ranking at the right (a 2x3 mini grid of heat maps, scene tiles and an expert demo). The regions are not framed and the loop arrows cross between them.

lesson: Colour each section heading and reuse that colour on its arrows and curves, and write the objective as a formula whose operands are the very green- and red-framed pictures of the ranking part, so the loss reads straight off the figure.
